headline: Did Capital One’s Q2 Profit Rebound and Dividend Moves Just Shift Capital One Financial's (COF) Investment Narrative?
summary: In July 2026, Capital One Financial reported much stronger second-quarter results, moving from a net loss a year earlier to net income of US$3,020 million, while also affirming a US$0.80 quarterly common dividend and declaring a range of preferred stock dividends payable in the second half of 2026. Alongside these earnings and capital return updates, the bank highlighted progress on its US$265 billion community investment plan linked to the Discover acquisition, underscoring how financial...
